root_idea.summary: The root denotes moving something aside, separating it, or causing it to be apart from another.
root_idea.development: Its central orientation develops from physical removal or separation into personal withdrawal, exclusion, and states or descriptions of being apart. Several specialized nominal and adjectival branches preserve the idea of being separate or lacking an associated feature, while some usages are lexically divergent.

senses.definition: To put or set apart; to remove or separate one thing from another.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence uses the verb for setting someone or something aside; the construction may express separation from another object or party.

senses.definition: To withdraw, go apart, or keep away from persons or things; to leave or forsake them.
senses.usage_conditions: The verb may be used transitively or intransitively, with bodily or inward withdrawal, and in requests to dissociate oneself from a person, group, practice, or affair.

senses.definition: To keep away from women in a sexual context; to refrain from sexual intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the Quranic construction فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ, used in the context of menstruation; it should not be generalized to every occurrence of the verb.

senses.definition: A place or state of removal, separation, or aloofness.
senses.usage_conditions: Often used with بِـ and عن to express being apart from a person, thing, affair, or group; the Quranic occurrence describes being aloof from the ark or its religious allegiance.

senses.definition: Set apart, excluded, debarred, or prevented from access.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression, the excluded ones are debarred from hearing the speech of the angels; the supplied Quran form is the masculine plural مَعْزُولُونَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove, depose, or displace an agent, deputy, or officeholder from authority or employment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن and an office, administration, agency, or government.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To practice coitus interruptus by withdrawing before emission and emitting semen outside the vagina.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sexual construction, especially عَزَلَ عَنْهَا; this is distinct from ordinary physical removal or separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to have its tail habitually inclining to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The inclination is habitual rather than an innate physical condition; an inclination to the right was considered unlucky by the Arabs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goods brought to the state treasury in advance of the due date of an instalment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The goods are described as not yet weighed or sorted to remove the inferior portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go apart, withdraw, or separate from one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction describing each person or party separating from the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state of having no weapon available.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may specifically mean having no spear, or more generally having no weapon with which to fight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deficiency in one of the two hip-bone crests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical usage referring to a defect or missing portion of one حَرْقَفَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hinder part of an ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Preserved in the idiom اِقْرَعْ عَزَلَ حِمَارِكَ, addressed to the driver of an ass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Withdrawal, retirement, or self-seclusion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can describe separation from association or communion and may be used of religious retirement or self-seclusion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The crest of a hip-bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun distinct from the related usage describing a deficiency in one of the crests.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower mouth, spout, or outlet of a leather water-bag.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term denotes the outlet near one of the lower corners of a مَزَادَة or similar water-bag; its plural includes عَزَالِي and عَزَالَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pouring outlets of a cloud, used figuratively for a cloud's or the sky's discharge of heavy rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as أَرْخَتْ عَزَالِيَهَا, the rain is likened to water pouring from the spouts of a water-bag.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical extension of the term for an outlet or spout.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weakness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun synonymous with ضَعْف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The goods, furniture, and utensils of a house or tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as a vulgar usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two feathers at the extremity of an eagle's tail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual expression whose plural is أَعْزِلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Separate or cut off from other sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a sandy area or tract distinguished from surrounding sand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unarmed, or lacking a spear or other weapon; by extension, lacking an associated weapon-like companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person without weapons and of the star al-Simāk al-Aʿzal, distinguished from al-Simāk al-Rāmiḥ by the absence of the star regarded as its spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird that cannot fly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage describing inability to fly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud in which there is no rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a rainless cloud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, having its tail habitually inclining to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The inclination is habitual rather than natural; the expression may occur in a proverbial description of an unarmed man on such a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deficient in one of the two hip-bone crests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival anatomical usage applied to an ass or similar animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The share of meat belonging to a man who is absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal or adjectival usage; its plural is عُزْلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep aloof from warfare or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of one who stays out of fighting, especially because he has no weapon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who keeps apart from others: especially a herdsman who pastures his animals in a remote place, a traveller who camps alone, one who separates from gambling companions, or one isolated in opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The herdsman's remoteness is not necessarily blameworthy and may be associated with courage; camping apart or separating from gambling companions can carry disapproval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weak and stupid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct adjectival usage recorded for the same form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Muʿtazilah, a theological sect whose name is associated with secession or withdrawal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A historical sectarian name, explained in relation to withdrawal from opposing theological parties or from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī's circle.
